ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Factory Additions
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Additions to Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory.
A "Belts may take from here" switch on every storage building, from any mod (shelves, Rimefeller's unloading bays, Adaptive Storage and Warehouse Storage buildings, and more). Switch it on and the conveyor belts beside it, and any factory machine whose input cell is on it, take from it as they would from a factory hopper. It starts off, so nothing moves until you say so.
An automated fabrication bay: a factory machine that makes what a fabrication bench makes (bionic and other artificial body parts, spacer weapons and armour), and with Anomaly or Dubs Rimatomics what a bioferrite shaper or a Rimatomics machining table makes. Its bills are built at load from each item's own recipe, so they follow other mods' changes and appear once the recipe is unlocked.
A fix for every factory machine: a finished batch no longer vanishes when the output hopper's stack has no room for it (most of VFE Factory's own bills could lose items this way). The machine waits instead.
A "Synthesize neutroamine from human meat" bill for the neutroamine synthesizer. People carry far more fat than game animals, so a batch gives a little more neutroamine than the same weight of animal meat. The stock bill keeps taking animal meat and stops taking human meat, so you choose which meat goes where. Nobody eats anything, and no Ideology thought fires.
A deep factory hopper: a factory hopper that holds four stacks on its one cell, so a machine can draw several ingredients from one input cell and a belt carrying mixed items does not jam on the first surplus stack.
With "[sbz] Fridge" active, conveyor belts and factory machines can take corpses straight out of its corpse fridge, as they do from a factory hopper.
Drug lab recipes from other mods as factory bills, each switched on only while its mod is active: Medicines+ (all its drugs, plus a penicillin-from-fungus bill), Deep Pills infusions, Ushankas Biological Warfare vaccines, antiserums and pills, Combat Extended psycho, Dubs Rimatomics potassium iodide, hemogen from Hemofungus, Complementary Odyssey vacsop and glitterworld medicine on the medicine granulator; Farmable Neutroamine leaves on the neutroamine synthesizer; Passive Exoskeletons polyamide and Simple Washing Machine detergent on the automated biofuel refinery. Every bill follows the stock rule (a batch of four at four times the lab's work) and keeps its mod's research.
Requires Harmony, Vanilla Expanded Framework and Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory. Uses Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded's piped chemfuel and Vanilla Races Expanded - Android's piped neutroamine when those mods are active.
